/**
 * Every branching construct ADR 0036 names a TypeScript counting rule for, one
 * function per shape, so a complexity walk can be checked against a number
 * derived by hand in the README beside this file.
 */

/** A ternary. */
export function pick(a: number, b: number): number {
  return a > b ? a : b;
}

/** Optional chaining on a member, and nullish coalescing. */
export function title(user: { name?: string } | null): string {
  return user?.name ?? "anonymous";
}

/** Optional chaining on a call. */
export function notify(fn?: (message: string) => void): void {
  fn?.("ping");
}

/** The three logical-assignment operators. */
export function settle(o: { a?: number; b?: number; c?: boolean }): void {
  o.a ??= 1;
  o.b ||= 2;
  o.c &&= false;
}

/** A catch clause. */
export function readNumber(text: string): number {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text) as number;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

/** Two non-default cases and a default, which does not count. */
export function describe(n: number): string {
  switch (n) {
    case 0:
      return "zero";
    case 1:
      return "one";
    default:
      return "many";
  }
}

/** Two default parameters, each desugaring to a real branch. */
export function greet(name = "world", punctuation = "!"): string {
  return `hello ${name}${punctuation}`;
}

/** A for-of, a while and a do-while. */
export function total(items: number[]): number {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    sum += item;
  }
  let i = 1;
  while (i < 2) {
    i += 1;
  }
  do {
    i -= 1;
  } while (i > 0);
  return sum;
}

/** An arrow used as a callback, whose branches fold into this function. */
export function evens(items: number[]): number[] {
  return items.filter((n) => n % 2 === 0 && n > 0);
}

/** An arrow written as a real declaration, which is its own scoring unit. */
export const bucket = (n: number): string => {
  if (n < 0) {
    return "negative";
  }
  return n > 10 ? "large" : "small";
};

/** A method, with an `if`, an `||` and an `&&`. */
export class Gate {
  private open = false;

  allow(user: string | null, admin: boolean): boolean {
    if (admin || (user !== null && user.length > 0)) {
      this.open = true;
    }
    return this.open;
  }
}
